issues.issue: [fixed] The rules list airport authorities as entirely business-type entities: every receipt/disbursement line should be fund_type business-type, the balances should go in business_type (beginning 153,998, ending 93,687), the top-level governmental balances should be null, reported_totals.governmental should be null and reported_totals.business-type should hold 102,948 / 163,259. The extractor recorded everything as governmental and said in notes that this was its own choice because the budget form does not separate fund types. Same problem in disbursements[*].fund_type, beginning_cash, ending_cash and reported_totals. If a person decides that tax-levy airport budget forms should be governmental, this becomes a decision_needed item.

No transportation/airport function category exists, so 'other' with review is defensible. Still, the budget-form rule says to use the entity type's function for Operating Expenses; a person may prefer a different function (e.g. economic development or general government).
